Owner(s).note: A MidAmerican Energy presentation filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission in 2015 lists Riverside Unit 5 among MidAmerican Energy's own coal-fueled generation. So it supports MidAmerican Energy as owner. It does not give a percentage share.

Conversion/replacement?.note: The same filing says Riverside Unit 5 of 124 MW ceased burning coal in 2015 and operates solely on natural gas. That is a conversion.

City.note: A WVIK public radio report on the closing of the last Quad Cities coal plant describes the MidAmerican Energy Riverside plant in Davenport.

units.notes: I found no document that states the coordinates, so they have no source yet. I found nothing that mentions carbon capture at this unit.
